title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1993-04-05
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Jim Wise's FOB Audience DAT > Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (hand-held ORTF) > Sonosax SX-M2 > Dat (Sony D10 Pro/48k); Transfer Info: DAT Master (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000> WAV (16-bit/48k)> Adobe Audition 3.0> TLH flac1648; Recorded & Transferred by Jim Wise; Mastered by Scott Clugston

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording captures a decent show with a nice Black‑Throated Wind and a rare second‑set closer, though the performance isn’t top‑tier.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for its clear, present sound that feels like you’re in the venue—far more listenable than the pinched board sources. The concert itself is described as “not the best show,” but it does feature a solid Black‑Throated Wind and an unusual rarity to end the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; recording quality is praised (good) while show quality is noted as merely average, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and immersive sound; more listenable than the pinched‑sounding board copies, with no mention of skips or major glitches.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall a middling performance, but highlighted by a strong Black‑Throated Wind and a rare closing piece that give the second set some shine.
